To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
voids in solder layer will reduce the reliability of solder layer, increase the crack growth rate and the thermal degradation of the solder layer.
void rate has a great impact on solder layer reliability.
the thermal degradation rate is related to the void rate and void location.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the reliability analysis and thermal resistance under harsh environment of high power device with voids.
the thermal resistance degradation of solder layer under the harsh condition.
thermal resistance degradation, which is the key factor of high-power devices heat dissipation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the thermal degradation of center and corner void is different.
void rate is the main factor of solder layer reliability, thermal degradation and crack growth rate.
the voids of center will reduce the reliability of welding layers more seriously, the crack growth rate of corner voids is higher, but the thermal resistance degradation of the corner voids is lower.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
when voids appear in welding layer, it can be predicted that the reliability of welding will decrease, crack growth rate will increase, and thermal degradation will occur.
the reliability of the welding layer will be greatly decreased by voids.

the reliability of solder joint with voids decreases sharply, the crack growth rate with voids increases sharply, the thermal degradation with voids increases slowly, and the thermal degradation of center and corner voids is basically same, but the maximum value of center void can be 2.3 times of that of corner void.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the voids in the center of the solder layer will reduce the reliability of the solder layer and increase the crack growth rate, but the voids in corner of solder layer will not only reduce the reliability of solder layer, but also increase the crack growth and thermal degradation.

the reliability of the welding layer will be significantly reduced with the occurrence of voids, the crack growth rate of welding layer with corner void is more serious than that with center voids, and the thermal degradation of corner void is more obvious than that of center void.
voids will reduce solder reliability, increase crack growth rate and increase thermal degradation of the solder layer.
